title: Read a new-unit proposal
responsibility: Validates a bounded agent proposal and builds the instructions used to request one.

inputs.name: projectProposal.answer
inputs.description: The agent response: one JSON object, optionally enclosed in one JSON Markdown fence. Trimmed response length is at most 20,000 characters. It must contain category, title, goal, proposal and contract only.

inputs.name: proposalPrompt.request
inputs.description: The requested catalog category and text. The category is presented as a hint, not forced as the proposal’s final category.

inputs.name: proposalPrompt.known
inputs.description: Known unit identities to include as allowed references; defaults to an empty list.

outputs.name: projectProposal
outputs.description: A proposal in one of the six catalog categories, with trimmed title, goal and notes. Title is at most 160 characters and cannot look like a path; goal is at most 600 and notes at most 6,000 with no code fences. Contract inputs, outputs and errors are required lists of at most 24 items. Field names/types and error strings are nonblank and at most 160 characters; duplicate errors are refused. Invalid answers throw before any write.

outputs.name: proposalPrompt
outputs.description: A prompt requesting exactly that proposal shape, allowing registry/contracts reading, forbidding writes and other units’ implementation reads, and appending the request and allowed references. It generates instructions only.
